scope_statement: This is a selective target-compatibility report, not a whole-manager compatibility or interchangeability claim.
provenance_statement: Compatibility on shared target cells does not establish that the candidate manager was used to fit the historical posterior.
candidate_only_statement: Candidate-only outcomes, including adap.clients, have no historical numeric compatibility evidence in the baseline display manager.
derived_check_statement: Derived-target checks establish formula consistency within the candidate manager; they do not establish historical identity of the inputs or derived values.
